premises.text: Internet giants need fast and secure websites to retain visitors and protect against threats
premises.evidence_span: you've got to make sure that your website is really, really fast... you've got to make sure your site is secure

premises.text: Most website operators lack access to the performance and security tools used by internet giants
premises.evidence_span: if you're trying to run a website today, you're left alone without access to any of these tools

premises.text: Cloudflare provides performance and security tools for any website without requiring hardware or software installation
premises.evidence_span: Cloudflare is a performance and security solution that takes the tools of the biggest service providers and makes them available for anyone with a website online

premises.text: Setting up Cloudflare takes about five minutes and requires only a change to the domain's name servers
premises.evidence_span: it takes about five minutes to set up... all you do is make one change to your domain's name servers

premises.text: Cloudflare can significantly decrease page load times and stop spam and attacks
premises.evidence_span: We deliver an average of a 30% decrease in page load times to your site... we stop virtually all the spam, attackers, other garbage that are coming to your site

premises.text: Cloudflare's service is free, making it accessible to a wide range of users
premises.evidence_span: there's really only one price point for a service like ours, and that's free

premises.text: Cloudflare has a proven track record of stopping threats and improving website performance
premises.evidence_span: we've stopped five million threats that would have otherwise got to our sites

value.text: Websites can be fast, safe, and secure for all users
value.evidence_span: our goal at the end of the day is to make the web a faster, safer place
